name: Notes
description: Short notes for the chat you're in: what it waits on, where its work is, steps left, decisions, links. You and Claude write them; Claude gets them with every message and keeps them current.

tools.description: This chat's notes (the Notes panel beside the chat), each with its id. They also come with every message (in <jig-context>); use this to read them again after changing several. A 'Waiting on' note that isn't cleared means that work shouldn't go ahead yet.

Adds a note to this chat's Notes panel, when the user asks and on your own for what this chat must keep in mind about its topic: what it waits on (wait), the branch its work lives on (where: repo and branch), decisions, constraints or facts later work must respect (note), parts deliberately left for later (todo), an address (link). Not a log: no notes for routine progress, files you change, commits to push or what you're doing now. A chat usually holds a handful; one short line each.

kind.description: wait, where, todo, note or link

text.description: The note, one short line; for where and link an optional remark

tools.description: Changes a note of this chat by its id: its words, repo, branch or url, or ticks a wait cleared / a to-do done (done: true) or opens it again. Update rather than add a near-duplicate.

id.description: The note's id, as the list shows it

tools.description: Removes a note from this chat by its id, when it's no longer true.
